pages.title: Restriction Table
pages.text: The table engraves restrictions into any item recognized by the system as a weapon. Place the weapon in the central slot, then select the restrictions to carve.

pages.title: Selecting Layers
pages.text: Left-click a sigil to add one layer and right-click to remove one. Hold Shift to change ten at once. Different restriction types may be mixed, but the total cannot exceed the tier's remaining capacity.

pages.title: Begin Carving
pages.text: Select at least one layer and press Carve to enter the Ling Shu Abacus. Every selected layer is applied together only after the formation is solved. Failure grants none of the selected layers.

pages.title: Seventy-Two Layers
pages.text: Each tier holds 72 layers. A weapon's Evolve action starts a tribulation at a full cycle. After success, existing restrictions merge into the artifact and remain effective; its current cycle resets and it advances one tier.$(br2)Armor and other non-weapon equipment follow different evolution rules.

pages.title: Artifact Tiers
pages.text: The tiers are Mortal Weapon, Spiritual Weapon, Treasure Weapon, Magic Treasure, Profound Treasure, Spirit Treasure, Dao Treasure, and Immortal Weapon. Immortal Weapon is currently the maximum.
